abstract: We study the impact of large, successful manufacturing plants on other local producers in China, focusing on “Million-Rouble Plants” built in the 1950s during a brief alliance with the U.S.S.R. The ephemeral geopolitical situation and the locations of allied and enemy airbases provide exogenous variation in plant siting. We find a boom-and-bust pattern: Counties hosting these plants were 80% more productive than control counties in 1982 but 20% less productive by 2010. This decline reflects the performance of local establishments, which exhibit low productivity, limited innovation, and high markup. Specialization hindered spillovers, preventing the emergence of new clusters and local entrepreneurship.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了中国大型成功制造工厂对其他本地生产者的影响，重点关注20世纪50年代中苏短暂结盟期间建设的“百万卢布工厂”。短暂的地缘政治局势以及盟军与敌军空军基地的位置为工厂选址提供了外生变异。我们发现了一种“繁荣-萧条”模式：1982年，拥有这些工厂的县的生产率比对照组县高出80%，但到2010年却低了20%。这一下降反映了本地企业的表现，这些企业呈现出低生产率、有限创新和高加价的特点。专业化阻碍了溢出效应，阻止了新集群的形成和本地创业精神的发展。

abstract: To detect the global community structure of multi-layer networks, individual layers might not provide sufficient information. It is of vital importance to effectively complement the information from the network data. In this paper, under the framework of multi-layer stochastic block model, a Spectral method with Moments integration and Bias Adjustment (SpecMBA) is proposed for community detection. The key distinguishing feature of SpecMBA is the adaptive integration of both the first and second moments of adjacency matrices with a hyperparameter α∈[−1,∞), which overcomes the limitations of fixed-form aggregation. Furthermore, SpecMBA adjusts for the bias caused by noise heteroskedasticity to mitigate signal distortion. In addition, a data-driven likelihood-based approach is proposed to select the optimal α. This adaptive aggregation ensures robust and competitive performance across diverse scenarios, which has been confirmed in the numerical studies. Under mild conditions, the community detection consistency for SpecMBA is established. The application on the international food trading network reveals interesting findings.
abstract_zh: 为检测多层网络的全局社区结构，单一层可能无法提供足够的信息。有效补充网络数据中的信息至关重要。本文在多层随机块模型框架下，提出了一种结合矩积分与偏差调整的谱方法（SpecMBA），用于社区检测。SpecMBA的关键特征在于，通过超参数α∈[−1,∞)自适应整合邻接矩阵的一阶和二阶矩，克服了固定形式聚合的局限性。此外，SpecMBA调整了由噪声异方差性引起的偏差，以减轻信号失真。同时，提出了一种基于似然的数据驱动方法，用于选择最优α。这种自适应聚合确保了在不同场景下的稳健且具有竞争力的性能，这一点已在数值研究中得到证实。在温和条件下，建立了SpecMBA的社区检测一致性。在国际食品贸易网络上的应用揭示了有趣的发现。
title: Moment-Integrated Bias-Adjusted Spectral Method for Community Detection in Multi-Layer Networks
title_zh: 多层网络中社区检测的矩积分偏差校正谱方法

abstract: In this paper, we propose a model-free feature screening framework tailored for high-dimensional and heterogeneous datasets, based on a novel distributionally robust dependence measure termed Copula Divergence. The proposed screening method, named CD-Screen, addresses critical limitations of existing feature screening methods, such as restrictive modeling assumptions and sensitivity to heterogeneous feature distributions. CD-Screen ranks features according to their Copula Divergence without relying on a specific regression model or distributional assumptions. Additionally, we introduce CD-FDR, a data-driven procedure to control false discoveries, ensuring accurate and efficient feature selection. Theoretical analyses establish the sure screening and rank consistency properties of CD-Screen, along with asymptotic control of the false discovery rate by CD-FDR. Extensive simulation studies demonstrate the superior performance of our methods compared to traditional screening approaches across diverse scenarios. Furthermore, a real data analysis of the relationship between stock returns and inflation in the United States illustrates the practical use of our method and provides descriptive evidence on sector-specific responses to economic changes.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种针对高维异质性数据集的无模型特征筛选框架，基于一种新颖的分布鲁棒性依赖度量——Copula散度。所提出的筛选方法名为CD-Screen，解决了现有特征筛选方法的关键局限性，如限制性建模假设和对异质性特征分布的敏感性。CD-Screen根据特征的Copula散度进行排序，无需依赖特定的回归模型或分布假设。此外，我们引入了CD-FDR，一种数据驱动的程序，用于控制错误发现率，确保特征选择的准确性和高效性。理论分析确立了CD-Screen的确定筛选和秩一致性性质，以及CD-FDR对错误发现率的渐近控制。广泛的模拟研究表明，在各种场景下，我们的方法相比传统筛选方法具有优越性能。此外，对美国股票收益与通货膨胀关系的实际数据分析展示了我们方法的实际应用，并提供了关于经济变化对部门特定响应的描述性证据。
title: Model-free and Distributionally Robust Feature Screening with False Discovery Control for High-Dimensional Heterogeneous Data
title_zh: 高维异质性数据的无模型与分布鲁棒特征筛选及错误发现控制

abstract: When exactly does a preference ordering on acts have an additive state-dependent utility representation per indifference curve? Following the analogy of a sliding balance, a perfect reflection of the well-known betweenness models for lotteries, we find three answers for monetary acts on a finite state space. In the first two, we exploit the axiom of weak decomposability, identified by Grant, Kajii, and Polak (2000) as the key axiom to extend betweenness to acts, but leaving the continuity and monotonicity of state utility in setpoints an open issue. Our first theorem confirms the necessity of continuity, while the second shows that monotonicty in setpoints requires the additional axiom of ratio monotonicity . It formalises the idea that sliding a setpoint towards a gain decreases its momentum compared to losses. This observation, in turn, suggests to extend the primitive of a preference ordering with a benchmark for discerning gains from losses within an act. Thus we arrive at the Additive Sliding Balance Utility model for orderings anchored to such a benchmark. In the third theorem, we characterise this class with an even more straightforward betweenness axiom: the balance point of an act should be in between those of its parts.
abstract_zh: 在何种精确条件下，行动上的偏好序能够为每条无差异曲线提供加性状态依赖效用表示？遵循滑动平衡的类比——这一概念完美反映了彩票理论中著名的中间性模型——我们针对有限状态空间上的货币行动给出了三种解答。前两种解答中，我们运用了格兰特、梶井与波拉克（2000）所识别的弱可分解性公理，该公理被视为将中间性扩展至行动的关键，但状态效用关于设定点的连续性与单调性仍为开放问题。第一定理证实了连续性的必要性，而第二定理表明设定点单调性需要额外引入比率单调性公理。该公理形式化了如下思想：将设定点向收益方向滑动会降低其相对于损失的动量。这一观察进而提示，应在偏好序的原始概念中引入一个基准，用以区分行动内部的收益与损失。由此，我们提出了针对锚定此类基准的序关系的加性滑动平衡效用模型。在第三定理中，我们通过一个更为直接的中间性公理刻画了该模型类别：行动的平衡点应介于其各组成部分的平衡点之间。
title: Balancing Acts
title_zh: 平衡之举

abstract: Whereas hydrogen is currently a marginal energy carrier, the aim of the EU is to trigger low-carbon hydrogen production that covers around 10 percent of EU’s energy needs by 2050. If this comes true, it will be an energy revolution. We study competition between green and blue hydrogen using an extended Salop model that encompasses the value chains for hydrogen and CCS. For blue hydrogen, we distinguish between exports of blue hydrogen—natural gas is converted into hydrogen close to the extraction site of natural gas and hydrogen is then transported over a long distance to the hydrogen consumers—and local production of blue hydrogen—natural gas is exported over a long distance and then converted into hydrogen near the hydrogen consumers. We find that mark-ups are highest in the case of exports of blue hydrogen production, which implies that total production of hydrogen, supply of blue hydrogen, and share of plants investing in carbon capture facilities are lower in the case of exports of blue hydrogen than in the case of local production of blue hydrogen. We provide numerical simulations of the alternative market outcomes and the corresponding first-best outcomes and identify policy instruments that should be used to sustain the first-best social outcomes in the cases of exports of blue hydrogen and local production of blue hydrogen.
abstract_zh: 尽管氢能目前仍是一种边缘能源载体，欧盟的目标是到2050年推动低碳氢能生产，使其覆盖欧盟约10%的能源需求。若这一目标实现，将引发一场能源革命。我们通过扩展萨洛普模型（Salop model）研究绿色氢能与蓝色氢能之间的竞争，该模型涵盖了氢能与碳捕集与封存（CCS）的价值链。针对蓝色氢能，我们区分了两种模式：蓝色氢能出口（在天然气开采地附近将天然气转化为氢能，再通过长距离运输至氢能消费端）与蓝色氢能本地生产（将天然气长距离出口至氢能消费端附近，再转化为氢能）。研究发现，蓝色氢能出口模式下的加价幅度最高，这意味着相较于蓝色氢能本地生产模式，出口模式下的氢能总产量、蓝色氢能供应量以及投资碳捕集设施的工厂占比均更低。我们通过数值模拟对比了不同市场结果与对应的最优社会结果，并识别出在蓝色氢能出口与本地生产两种模式下，用于维持最优社会结果的政策工具。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects 1
title_zh: 绿色氢与蓝色氢的竞争及间接网络效应

abstract: This paper examines the impact of two massive and unexpected inflows of Ukrainian migrants on voting behavior in Poland. In particular, we examine the effects of a conflict-induced labor migration shock and a refugee shock resulting from Russia’s aggression against Ukraine in 2014 and 2022, respectively. Using an instrumental variable approach, we find that greater exposure to labor migrants reduces support for conservative parties in the short run and subsequently shifts voter preferences toward pro-redistribution parties. Exposure to labor migrants as well as to refugees leads to a decrease in far-right voting. This effect emerges only after the salience of Ukrainian migrants increases due to the escalation of Russia’s aggression and the rise of anti-Ukrainian rhetoric from the Polish far-right. The backlash from Polish voters against far-right rhetoric is ten times stronger in areas with stronger exposure to refugees than in areas with greater exposure to labor migrants. Our results are robust to the use of a number of instruments and several sensitivity checks.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了两次大规模且出人意料的乌克兰移民流入对波兰投票行为的影响。具体而言，我们分别研究了2014年因冲突引发的劳动力迁移冲击和2022年因俄罗斯侵略乌克兰导致的难民冲击所产生的影响。采用工具变量方法，我们发现，短期内对劳动力移民的更大暴露会降低对保守党的支持，并随后将选民偏好转向支持再分配的政党。对劳动力移民及难民的暴露均导致极右翼投票减少。这一效应仅在乌克兰移民的显著性因俄罗斯侵略升级及波兰极右翼反乌克兰言论抬头而增强后才显现。波兰选民对极右翼言论的反弹在难民暴露更强的地区比劳动力移民暴露更大的地区强十倍。我们的结果在使用多种工具变量及多项敏感性检验后依然稳健。
title: Migration shocks and voting: Evidence from Ukrainian migration to Poland
title_zh: 移民冲击与投票：来自乌克兰移民至波兰的证据

abstract: While the global space economy continues to rapidly grow, and public policy challenges related to satellites and debris in orbit emerge, there is surprisingly little evidence connecting theoretical economic frameworks with observed orbital usage. Using a state-of-the-science integrated assessment model combining economic modeling with physical models of the space environment, we find the observed distribution of satellite orbits is well-explained by profit-maximizing satellite operator behavior. Furthermore, we find strong evidence that collision risk plays a key deterrence role. Finally, the observed location of the largest satellite constellation, Starlink, is consistent with a “sole owner” over particularly economically desirable altitudes.
abstract_zh: 全球太空经济继续快速增长，与轨道卫星和碎片有关的公共政策挑战不断显现，但将理论经济学框架与实际轨道使用联系起来的证据却出人意料地稀少。本文使用一个结合经济模型与太空环境物理模型的前沿综合评估模型，发现观测到的卫星轨道分布可以由卫星运营商利润最大化行为很好地解释。进一步结果表明，碰撞风险发挥了重要的威慑作用。最后，最大卫星星座 Starlink 的实际部署位置，与其在经济价值尤其高的轨道高度上表现为“单一所有者”的行为相一致。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Do economic principles explain orbital use in space?
title_zh: 经济原理能否解释太空轨道利用？

abstract: Monotonicity and recursivity are central assumptions in intertemporal consumption problems under ambiguity. We show that monotone recursive preferences admit both a recursive and an ex-ante representation, and that the certainty equivalent functionals associated with these representations are translation invariant. Translation invariance implies that the decision maker’s ambiguity attitudes are constant, in the sense that they do not vary with the level of welfare or utility. Finally, we establish an equation linking the two certainty equivalent functionals that extends the notion of rectangularity for recursive multiple priors, which we call generalized rectangularity. This equation yields a simple, testable condition for dynamic consistency.
abstract_zh: 单调性和递归性是模糊环境下跨期消费问题的核心假设。我们证明，单调递归偏好既允许递归表示，也允许事前表示，并且与这些表示相关的确定性等价函数具有平移不变性。平移不变性意味着决策者的模糊态度是恒定的，即它们不随福利或效用水平的变化而变化。最后，我们建立了一个连接这两个确定性等价函数的方程，该方程扩展了递归多先验的矩形性概念，我们称之为广义矩形性。此方程提供了一个简单且可检验的动态一致性条件。
title: Recursive Preferences and Ambiguity Attitudes
title_zh: 递归偏好与模糊态度

abstract: Climate change is predicted to have large and heterogeneous impacts on agricultural yields. I use a model of production, consumption, and trade of 24 crops between 271 regions across sub-Saharan Africa to simulate the effects of climate change and explore how trade mediates these effects. I estimate a continent-wide welfare loss equivalent to 2.4% of GDP using median yield changes across 5 climate models, with country-level losses up to 60% of GDP in the worst model. The continent-wide welfare loss is 19% smaller with lower trade costs and over 7 times larger if trade flows are capped at current levels.
abstract_zh: 气候变化预计将对农业产量产生巨大且异质性的影响。本文利用一个涵盖撒哈拉以南非洲271个地区、24种作物生产、消费与贸易的模型，模拟气候变化的影响，并探讨贸易如何调节这些效应。基于5个气候模型的中位产量变化，我估算出全大陆福利损失相当于GDP的2.4%，而在最差模型下，国家层面的损失高达GDP的60%。当贸易成本较低时，全大陆福利损失减少19%；若贸易流量被限制在当前水平，损失则扩大7倍以上。
title: Agricultural trade and adaptation to climate change in sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的农业贸易与气候变化适应

abstract: This article analyses the notion of Ecological Rationality in the context of decision making under uncertainty. It suggests that constructivist approaches, namely constructivist rationality, are not adapted to solve problems faced in the real ecological environments, which imply large world problems and intractability. The complexity of the decision problems imply search and information costs and thus heuristics, as exhibited by human decision makers might be optimal. It is suggested that inverse S-shaped probability weighting as exhibited by most decision makers might be optimal when facing real world environments. It is shown that the maximum entropy approach can be used to model such kind of behaviour as an approximation to the inverse S-shaped probability weighting. It is argued that this approach is ecologically rational and that such a heuristic can be used to treat financial and econometric decision problems and be a calibrated to decision-makers ambiguity aversion.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了不确定性决策背景下“生态理性”的概念。研究指出，建构主义方法（即建构理性）并不适用于解决真实生态环境中的问题，这类问题涉及“大世界”困境与不可解性。决策问题的复杂性意味着搜索成本与信息成本的存在，因此人类决策者所展现的启发式策略可能具有最优性。研究表明，多数决策者表现出的反S形概率权重在真实环境决策中可能具有最优性。本文论证了最大熵方法可作为反S形概率权重的近似模型来模拟此类行为，并指出该路径具有生态理性特征，可应用于金融与计量经济决策问题，同时能校准决策者的模糊厌恶倾向。
title: Ecological rationality and the maximum entropy heuristic
title_zh: 生态理性与最大熵启发式

abstract: Firm heterogeneity in financial constraints is a quantitatively important driver of how monetary policy transmits to inflation. Using detailed microdata on Swedish public and private firms, and high-frequency monetary policy surprises around Riksbank announcements, we document that smaller, financially constrained firms adjust prices significantly less than larger firms in response to changes in monetary policy. This heterogeneous price response materially dampens the aggregate PPI inflation response to monetary policy. Models of customer markets and financial frictions can explain our findings: because the external finance premium rises after a monetary contraction, constrained firms cut prices less to preserve cash flows, sacrificing future market share. Additional evidence on heterogeneous sales, debt, marginal cost, and markup responses further supports this channel. We consider several alternative explanations, including differences in price adjustments, working capital, market share, and export share, but these cannot explain our main heterogeneity result.
abstract_zh: 企业融资约束的异质性在货币政策向通胀传导过程中具有重要的定量意义。基于瑞典上市与非上市企业的微观数据，结合瑞典央行公告前后高频货币政策意外冲击，我们发现：相较于大型企业，规模较小且面临融资约束的企业在应对货币政策变化时，其价格调整幅度显著更低。这种异质性价格响应实质上削弱了货币政策对总体生产者价格指数（PPI）通胀的影响。客户市场模型与金融摩擦理论可解释这一发现：由于货币紧缩后外部融资溢价上升，受约束企业为维持现金流而减少降价幅度，从而牺牲未来市场份额。关于销售额、债务、边际成本及加成率异质性的额外证据进一步支持该传导渠道。我们考察了包括价格调整成本、营运资本、市场份额及出口份额在内的多种替代性解释，但这些因素均无法解释核心异质性结论。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为瑞典企业，数据与政策背景均不涉及中国
title: Prices and Monetary Policy: The Role of Financial Constraints
title_zh: 价格与货币政策：金融约束的作用

abstract: Firms in low- and middle-income countries rarely advertise their vacancies formally and instead use social networks to find employees. We experimentally reduce the cost of formal employee search for small and medium-sized enterprises in Ethiopia to test whether informal search constrains the number and type of positions firms create. We find that treated firms increase formal search and shift their labor demand towards more demanding white-collar positions. However, they struggle to fill these newly created vacancies. We provide suggestive evidence that expectations contribute to this result, especially when firms lack prior experience with formal hiring channels: firms appear overly optimistic about the applicant pools formal search will generate, and job-seekers’ wage expectations exceed firms’ wages.
abstract_zh: 中低收入国家的企业很少正式发布招聘广告，而是利用社交网络寻找员工。我们通过实验降低埃塞俄比亚中小企业正式员工搜索的成本，以检验非正式搜索是否限制了企业创造的职位数量与类型。我们发现，受处理的企业增加了正式搜索，并将其劳动力需求转向要求更高的白领职位。然而，这些企业难以填补新设立的职位空缺。我们提供的初步证据表明，预期因素促成了这一结果，尤其是当企业缺乏正式招聘渠道的先前经验时：企业似乎对正式搜索将产生的应聘者群体过于乐观，而求职者的工资预期超过了企业的工资水平。
title: Formalized employee search and labor demand
title_zh: 正式化的员工搜寻与劳动力需求

abstract: We examine the role of state-dependent distribution frictions in the transmission of monetary policy shocks in a dynamic multi-sector general equilibrium model. Our benchmark model predicts a counter-cyclical distribution margin, which is consistent with micro price evidence. We then estimate an augmented model with price and wage rigidities and attribute the lion’s share of this countercyclicality to service-sector productivity shocks. By allowing for distribution frictions to depend on the state of the economy, which substantially alters monetary transmission, we find that state dependence weakens the real effects of monetary policy by dampening the consumption response to monetary shocks. In stark contrast, such a result cannot be replicated when distribution frictions are time-invariant. Our findings highlight a novel channel through which the interplay between sectoral productivity and distribution frictions jointly influences monetary policy transmission.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了状态依赖型分销摩擦在动态多部门一般均衡模型中对货币政策冲击传导的作用。我们的基准模型预测了一个逆周期的分销利润率，这与微观价格证据相符。随后，我们估计了一个包含价格和工资粘性的扩展模型，并将这种逆周期性的主要部分归因于服务部门的生产率冲击。通过允许分销摩擦依赖于经济状态，这显著改变了货币传导机制，我们发现状态依赖性通过抑制消费对货币冲击的反应，削弱了货币政策的实际效应。与此形成鲜明对比的是，当分销摩擦为时间不变时，无法复制这一结果。我们的发现突显了一个新颖的渠道，通过该渠道，部门生产率与分销摩擦之间的相互作用共同影响货币政策的传导。
title: State-dependent distribution friction and the transmission of monetary policy
title_zh: 状态依赖型分配摩擦与货币政策的传导

abstract: We show that the formalization of representativeness (Kahneman and Tversky (1972)) developed by Gennaioli and Shleifer (2010) features an intrinsic connection between uncertainty and overreaction. In the time series domain, we develop this connection in a smooth version of Diagnostic Expectations (DE), where overreaction varies smoothly with uncertainty. Intuitively, under smoothness, lower uncertainty leaves less room for representativeness to distort beliefs. Smooth DE provides a joint, parsimonious micro-foundation for key features of survey data: overreaction to news, stronger overreaction at longer horizons, overconfidence in subjective uncertainty, and a new stylized fact documented here—overreaction intensifies with higher uncertainty. An analytical Real Business Cycle model with Smooth DE accounts for survey overreaction and overconfidence, as well as three salient business cycle properties: asymmetry, countercyclical macro volatility, and countercyclical micro volatility.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，Gennaioli 和 Shleifer（2010）对 Kahneman 和 Tversky（1972）所提出的代表性概念的形式化，与不确定性和过度反应之间存在内在联系。在时间序列领域，我们在诊断性预期（DE）的平滑版本中发展了这一联系，其中过度反应随不确定性平滑变化。直观而言，在平滑条件下，较低的不确定性为代表性扭曲信念留下的空间更小。平滑诊断性预期为调查数据的若干关键特征提供了统一且简约的微观基础：对新闻的过度反应、在更长期限上更强的过度反应、对主观不确定性的过度自信，以及本文记录的一个新典型事实，即不确定性越高，过度反应越强。一个结合平滑诊断性预期的解析性真实经济周期模型，既能解释调查数据中的过度反应和过度自信，也能解释商业周期的三个显著特征：不对称性、宏观波动的逆周期性以及微观波动的逆周期性。
title: Smooth Diagnostic Expectations
title_zh: 平滑诊断性预期

abstract: Focus Exuberance about new technologies often brings about investment booms. The race among firms to capture a share of the revenues can result in excessive investment that makes the boom prone to a disruptive end. The boom-bust cycle recurs across history, from the canal and railway manias of the 19th century to the dotcom boom of the 1990s. The current artificial intelligence (AI) build-out ranks among the largest technology-driven investment booms in US history. Could it share the same fate as prior episodes?
abstract_zh: 对新技术的狂热关注常常引发投资热潮。企业为争夺收入份额而展开的竞争可能导致过度投资，使热潮容易以破坏性结局收场。从19世纪的运河与铁路狂热到20世纪90年代的互联网泡沫，繁荣-萧条周期在历史上反复出现。当前的人工智能基础设施建设规模，堪称美国历史上规模最大的技术驱动型投资热潮之一。它是否会重蹈此前历次热潮的覆辙？
title: The AI investment race
title_zh: 人工智能投资竞赛

abstract: How much did France pay for its colonial empire? Did colonies benefit from large transfers from French taxpayers and private investors, or were they, on the contrary, drained of their capital? This paper uses novel budgetary, private investment, and loan data to compute monetary flows between France and the colonies between 1833 and 1962. Public expenditure spent by France on the empire represented only 1.3 percent of its GDP, of which four-fifths was for the military. Trade balance deficits of French colonies were not counterbalanced by large public or private capital transfers from France to the colonies, but by military expenditure from the metropole. Overall, large sums of money were flowing from the colonies to the metropole, a “drain” representing a couple of percentage points of colonial GDP, making French colonies comparable to British India in the twentieth century.
abstract_zh: 法国为其殖民帝国付出了多少代价？殖民地是否从法国纳税人和私人投资者的大规模转移中获益，还是相反，其资本被抽空？本文利用1833年至1962年间法国与殖民地之间新的预算、私人投资和贷款数据，计算了双方的资金流动。法国在帝国上的公共支出仅占其GDP的1.3%，其中五分之四用于军事。法国殖民地的贸易逆差并未通过法国向殖民地的大规模公共或私人资本转移来弥补，而是由宗主国的军事支出所抵消。总体而言，大量资金从殖民地流向宗主国，这种“抽血”相当于殖民地GDP的几个百分点，使得法国殖民地在20世纪与英属印度具有可比性。
title: Colonialism on the Cheap: The French Empire 1830–1962
title_zh: 廉价殖民主义：法兰西帝国（1830–1962）

abstract: The EU Recovery and Resilience Facility was launched to support post-Covid recovery while accelerating structural transformation through investment and reform. This column provides a preliminary descriptive assessment of the macroeconomic impact of the facility in Italy, Greece, and Spain, three countries with large allocations. Using simple counterfactual comparisons, it presents evidence consistent with a positive impact on real GDP, and an even stronger impact on employment and investment in the three countries. The evidence also points to an expected positive impact on potential output in the years ahead.
abstract_zh: 欧盟复苏与韧性基金旨在支持疫情后经济复苏，同时通过投资与改革加速结构性转型。本专栏对意大利、希腊和西班牙这三个获得大额拨款的国家的基金宏观经济影响进行了初步描述性评估。通过简单的反事实比较，研究提供了与三国实际GDP正向影响相一致的证据，且对就业和投资的促进作用更为显著。证据还表明，该基金有望在未来几年对潜在产出产生积极影响。
title: The macroeconomic impact of the Recovery and Resilience Facility: An analysis for Italy, Spain, and Greece
title_zh: 复苏与韧性基金对宏观经济的影响：意大利、西班牙和希腊的分析

abstract: The idea of equal cumulative emissions per person is simple: every individual should have an equal claim on the atmosphere regardless of where they live. Using historical population and emissions data from 1870 onward, this column examines how the world’s remaining carbon budget could be allocated fairly across countries. European states have already consumed more than their share, whereas many developing countries retain positive claims. Allocating the remaining budget fairly can be compatible with development goals if developing countries can access cleaner technologies. Europe can start by redesigning the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism to embed explicit fairness principles.
abstract_zh: 人均累计排放量平等的理念简洁明了：无论居住何地，每个人都应平等享有对大气资源的权利。本文基于1870年以来的历史人口与排放数据，探讨如何在全球剩余碳预算中实现国家间的公平分配。欧洲国家已超额消耗其份额，而众多发展中国家仍保有正向权益。若发展中国家能够获取清洁技术，公平分配剩余碳预算可与可持续发展目标兼容。欧洲可率先改革碳边境调节机制，将明确的公平原则嵌入其中。
authors: Galina Hale, Michael Halling, Nora Paulus, Han Pham
title: Climate fairness, economic development, and Europe’s responsibility
title_zh: 气候公平、经济发展与欧洲的责任
